snippet.title: Malhaar | Official Gameplay Trailer #indiegame #newgame #cozygames
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3581900/Malhaar/

A musical slice-of-life RPG where you play as a musician and luthier who has just arrived in the mystical city that lives and breathes music. Learn to play sitar, put up tiny music shows, craft and tune musical instruments, serve at the local cafe, solve puzzles and unravel the mysterious stories of the lingering musical spirits that only appear during the season of the fireflies.

____
